cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Acknowledge the Disrespect
cards.instruction: Make someone apologize for the disrespect to your position, not merely for what happened.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll restore order in this meeting. Your apology needs to cover interrupting the chair, as well as the spilled tea.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The trousers can wait. Use whatever words feel natural, but I need the chair's position respected.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll apologize quietly. I'm not making a speech about it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Quietly is fine. Lean this way and say you shouldn't have interrupted the chair. Then I'll thank you and we can continue as a cooperative meeting.

reason: Give the chair a genuine concession on privacy and wording while keeping role-specific disrespect, not material damage, as the required apology.
